Balance sheet is the government-wide Total column p1 (internal balance nets to zero, not listed). The all-funds budget schedule on p10 is not broken out by fund, so not recorded in detail (statement-level actuals already captured). Detail covers General Fund by department (p12), Street (p13) and Fitness Center (p14); utility detail only in statement p7. Public Building mapped to general government.
